question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes **the activities of chimpanzees both in the trees and on the ground.**
 
• The appropriate conjunction should indicate that** their day involves activities in both locations.**
 
• "**both**" fits well as it accurately conveys the involvement of chimpanzees in activities occurring in two separate places.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no.1 is** 'both'**

​Hence, the correct sentence should read** "****Chimpanzees awaken at dawn, and their day is spent both__ in the trees and on the ground. "**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("either", "neither", "all") do not correctly convey the dual nature of chimpanzees' activities as described in the passage.

 
• **Either **(या): "Either" implies one of two choices but does not fit the context of activities occurring in both places.
 
• **Neither **(न): "Neither" implies none of the options and counters the dual context described.
 
• **All** (सभी): "All" implies multiple choices but isn't suitable to imply just two specific places referenced.
